name: Meitav Investment House Ltd
summary: Meitav Investment House Ltd functions as a publicly traded investment management firm, providing its services to a diverse clientele comprising private individuals, businesses, and institutional investors. Based in Tel Aviv, Israel, the company's core operations are centered on fund management activities exclusively within the Israeli market. It oversees a comprehensive range of financial vehicles, including bespoke investment portfolios, mutual funds, provident funds, as well as specialized pension, education, and other purpose-driven funds. The firm adopted its current name, Meitav Investment House Ltd, in July 2013, having previously operated under the name DS Apex Holdings Ltd.
